caption: The drawing features a single wooden cabinet standing on four short legs against a plain, beige background. The cabinet consists of two sections: an upper compartment with a prominent, centrally placed keyhole and metal hardware, and a lower section with two vertical doors. The upper compartment door has a geometric design outlined with red accents on the edges, and the lower doors have rectangular panels outlined similarly in red. Both sections have a visible wood grain texture, and the colors mainly include shades of brown and tan with red highlights and small black metal hardware details. The composition centers the cabinet on the page, with no other objects or decorations visible.
title: Two Drawer Sunflower Chest - side view
